title: Let Frankie Cook
description:
S01 E04 — Pasta From Scratch
Frankie explores his Italian roots, pairing each pasta shape with its perfect sauce-from Cavatelli with Super Green Sauce to Pappardelle in pork ragout, ricotta Gnocchi with punchy anchovy pecorino, and cozy Squash Orzotto with bloomed poppy seeds.

title: Let Frankie Cook
description:
S01 E05 — Getting the Band Back Together
Frankie reunites his old band for a jam session and a spin on a college-era classic - featuring Shoyu Ramen with Tare Eggs, sweet and savory Chicken Meatballs, Seaweed Cucumber Salad, and a crispy Okonomiyaki pancake.

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E02 — Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils
Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E01 — Not Your Nonna's Risotto
Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits.

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E04 — Comforting Mushroom Soup and Cheesy Soda Bread
Jamie cooks a comforting mushroom soup with cheap air-fryer soda bread for under a fiver, stretches ham hocks into a second teardrop gnocchi meal, makes a low-cost air-fryer chicken burger takeaway clone, and bakes thrifty frozen-berry iced buns!

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E10 — Hacienda Ranch Food
Pati makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, and cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with a pickled grape salad. In Sonora, she visits a traditional hacienda, where she gets a true taste of Sonoran ranch food.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E08 — Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt
Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E05 — The Magic of Piloncillo
The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E07 — Cantina Culture and the Morning After?
Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E09 — Cooking for the Crew
Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast for the crew - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E10 — Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs
Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E09 — A Day With Hugo
Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E04 — Bread Masters
Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S09 E11 — Breakfast for Dinner
It's dinnertime and breakfast is on the menu this week. These affordable breakfast specials are hearty enough for dinner, and so delicious they may even taste better after dark. Grab a fork and dig in for the most important meal of the day!

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S02 E04 — The Weekly Struggle Budget
Frankie figured out the weekly budget grocery equation so you don't have to. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner for seven days, for a family of four, for under $150. All it takes is a little planning, meal prep, and using up leftovers in inventive ways.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S03 E08 — Spring Fling
Spring is in the air which means a whole new world opens up in the produce department, especially all the greens. Frankie teaches us how to cook with mother nature, spring-style. It's tasty, seasonably affordable, and pretty to look at.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S09 E09 — Grubby Good Food
Send your taste buds on a first class food tour without even leaving the Struggle kitchen! Frankie whips up his favorite regional specialties from five destinations, making them as authentic as possible while sticking to his budget.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S02 E06 — Turn Up For Tomatoes
Tomatoes are one of the most produced fruits, especially when in season. Frankie teaches us how to prepare them fresh in a variety of ways. And for even more savings, Frankie will share a few tips on how to preserve tomatoes.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S03 E06 — Mushroom Mania
Frankie takes us on a magical mushroom trip. They're packed with nutritional value, and they're an affordable plant-based meat replacement. We'll learn about all things mushrooms and how to make some inventive, flavorful dishes.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S02 E09 — Frankie & Flour
Flour has the superpower to transform into an endless variety of meals, and a little goes a long way. Frankie teaches us how to make three different meals using flour as the affordable vehicle. Save money, learn new techniques.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S04 E10 — 5-Ingredient Recipes
These five-ingredient recipes are anything but boring; with a few pantry staples, these simple weeknight meals will be on the table in no time.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S02 E08 — Lunches for Work
A big way to save money on a struggle budget is to prepare homemade lunches for work. Frankie shows us how to make five delicious lunches for the whole work week. Each one flavored differently during meal prep so you don't get bored.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E02 — Homemade-ish
Last minute company leaving you in a pinch? Frankie has you covered with these easy recipes featuring store bought staples. With a few Struggle tips, these basic ingredients can be transformed into dishes that will impress your guests.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S03 E07 — No Kitchen No Problem
Just because you're dorm living, road tripping, motel living, or haven't gotten that bachelor pad in shape yet, doesn't mean you can't make tasty meals from some handy kitchen (and non-kitchen) appliances. No Kitchen? No problem.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E01 — One Pot Meals
Any true struggle cook knows there's nothing better than a one pot dinner. Not only is there hardly any cleanup at the end, but the prep is minimal too, which means hunger satisfaction is imminent. Who says meals can't be cheap, easy and delicious?

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E10 — Potato Variety Show
Frankie's slicing, mashing and smashing his way through the spud species, a staple for any Struggle kitchen.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E03 — Salad Salad Salad
Amp up your salad game with a little mixing and matching, from light and leafy greens to crisp and hearty toppings, and dressings for all occasions. Frankie shows us how versatile and fulfilling a homemade salad can truly be.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S03 E04 — Beans Beans Beans
Dried beans are affordable and healthy to prepare. Frankie will teach the basics of preparing beans from scratch while making tasty recipes. We also take a field trip to the grocery store to shop the bulk aisle. They're also good for your heart.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E02 — Bring Your Own Lunch
Frankie is all about BYOL - bring your own lunch. It's not only good for your wallet, it's good for your health. Skip the vending machine and the cafeteria in favor of creative, cost-effective and easy-to-transport midday meals.

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E04 — Jarred Pepper Pasta and Sheet Pan Brisket
Jamie cooks a speedy jarred-pepper pasta, crispy chicken in baked-bread sauce, and a beef brisket tray bake - all prepped in minutes. He makes shelf-raid spiced haricot beans, and rounds it all off with a fast and simple strawberry & balsamic tart.

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E05 — Smash Burger and Creamy Chicken with Mushrooms
Jamie cooks a midweek meal of speedy sweet pea chicken, a juicy Smash burger and a chicken and mushroom rice traybake. He batch-cooks his seven-veg sauce, followed by a spicy fish soup. And finishes off with a perfect pudding of tinned fruit granita.

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E03 — Easy Pantry Staple Fish Cakes
Jamie shares a simple salmon dish perfect for a midweek meal, and some no-fuss fish cakes made from tins. He cooks a lamb Madras traybake, as well as a no-cook pasta sauce, and crowns it all off with a hot and crispy ice cream parcel!

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E01 — Gochujang Chicken Sheet Pan Dinner
Jamie cooks a speedy midweek chicken tray bake. He shows us cool ways to upgrade salmon, knocks up a shelf-raid quesadilla toastie, and transforms a batch-cook Bolognese into cheesy bread bowls. All finished off with a super simple banoffee tart.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E04 — Hickory Smoked Virginia Ham & Mint Juleps
Pat Martin gets a history lesson on the origin of American barbecue from "The Professor" Tuffy Stone.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E02 — Searching for Oaxaca in Tennessee
Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E02 — Live Fire Whole Trout
Pat Martin heads to the Cherokee National Forest for a day of fly-fishing with an old friend, and to cook up their fresh catch over the campfire.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E10 — South Carolina's Coastal Fish Grill
Pat fishes the coastal inlets of Charleston, South Carolina, in search of a delicious sheepshead, which he plans to grill with his friend and chef James London.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E10 — The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E04 — How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home
Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E03 — Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew
Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella
Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E02 — Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice
We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E05 — The Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye
It's Steak Day! We're making a Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye; Steak & Eggs; Carne Asada Tacos with Refried Beans and Charred Tomato Salsa; and a Grilled Pork Chop with a Peach Glaze.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E03 — Every Kind of Rib: Dino, Fried, Smoked, Grilled and Glazed
It's Rib Day on BBQ Smokeout! Noah and Kev are cooking Dino Beef Ribs, Fried St. Louis Pork Ribs, Smoked Pork Spare Ribs with a Hennessey Glaze, and Smoke-Grilled Baby Backs. Plus we're making good old fashioned Dirty Cabbage.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E04 — Louisiana Style Crawfish Boil
It's Crawfish Boil Day on the show. Noah and Kev are making a gigantic Crawfish Boil; plus Smoked King Crab Legs; Grilled Rainbow Trout with Brown Butter and Grilled Lemon; and Kev's famous Red Beans and Rice.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S01 E03 — Why LA's Danger Dog is the Best Thing You'll Ever Eat
Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S01 E02 — The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.

description:
S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese
Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E10 — The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E07 — Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions
Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots
Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E09 — Game Day Chicago-Style Beef Sandwich
Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad
Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

description:

Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E06 — Smoked Brisket Hero
Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters.

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E02 — Steakhouse Hero
Susie's bringing in a special guest so you can bring the steakhouse to your backyard! Christie Vanover of Girls Can Grill joins the fun and brings some fingerling potatoes to round out the ribeyes, asparagus, and a one-of-a-kind compound butter!

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E03 — Pulled Pork Party Hero
It's always kind of a party in the backyard, but it's really a party when Susie breaks out the smoker for some legendary pulled pork sliders, a homemade coleslaw, and a mac and cheese so creamy even the grownups will rave about it.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E02 — Bougie Badass Burgers
Chef Dale Talde brings your basic burgers to a new level with his dry-aged beef burger with potatoes and truffle Dijon mayo, a part-beef part-pork belly burger with cheddar & an egg, and lastly a crispy mushroom tortilla burger with salsa & cheese.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S04 E01 — The Art of Open Fire Cooking
Chef Dale goes back to the roots of cooking, building a grill over an open fire to serve up a variety of dishes, including whole smoked chicken and fish, roasted cauliflower, a sweet and tangy grilled pineapple s'more dessert.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S05 E06 — Taco Like It's Hot
Taco night, Dale-style! Puffy al pastor tacos stuffed with pineapple-chile pork, grilled chicken pipian with charred tomato sauce, crispy street corn ribs, and dulce de leche empanadas. Taco Tuesday who?

title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ
description:
S01 E01 — Grilled Steak Salad and Italian-style Lamb Chops
Jamie shares his perfect Steak & Chargrilled Salad, a Chicken Caesar Salad with an upgrade on the bars, Italia-inspired Sizzling Lamb Lollipops and his delicious Whole Barbecue Fish & Ratatouille to upgrade your grill skills!

title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ
description:
S01 E03 — Sesame Chicken Burger and Surf & Turf Mixed Grill
Jamie takes outdoor cooking to new heights with his Ultimate Barbecue Breakfast, a smoke-kissed Sesame Chicken Burger, his Veggie Barbecue Mezze offering an epic spread; and his Surf & Turf Mixed Grill is a perfect party crowd-pleaser!

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S09 E05 — Happy Halloween
Boo! It's spooky season, and what better way to get into the spirit than with affordable, party-friendly Halloween dishes that scream trick or treat?! But be warned, these meals are scary good.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E01 — Summer BBQ
Summer is coming to a close, but there's still a bounty of fresh, seasonal produce to enjoy. Celebrate with Frankie as he makes some of his favorite cookout classics that'll take you from a weekend picnic to a backyard BBQ, with or without a grill.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S09 E08 — Meals Under $7
At a loss when your pantry is empty? With these recipes, you can walk into any grocery store with only $7 and walk out with everything you need for an entire meal. Because yes, you can whip up a nutritious meal at an affordable price!

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S03 E05 — Rent Week
It's that time, the first of the month, when you spend your whole paycheck on rent and bills. Your fridge looks pretty sad and the grocery budget is low. Frankie cooks up some go-to pantry meals and also teaches us how to better prepare for this.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E03 — Eat Your Greens
Going green isn't just a trend; it's a no-brainer! When the veggies are in season and the prices are at their lowest, Frankie's colorful recipes and zero waste tips will have you celebrating the savings with fresh spring produce.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E07 — Let's Play Ball
No matter who you're rooting for, savor these ballpark favorites while beating those major league prices.

description:
S02 E03 — Every Kind of Rib: Dino, Fried, Smoked, Grilled and Glazed
It's Rib Day on BBQ Smokeout! Noah and Kev are cooking Dino Beef Ribs, Fried St. Louis Pork Ribs, Smoked Pork Spare Ribs with a Hennessey Glaze, and Smoke-Grilled Baby Backs. Plus we're making good old fashioned Dirty Cabbage.

description:
S02 E04 — Louisiana Style Crawfish Boil
It's Crawfish Boil Day on the show. Noah and Kev are making a gigantic Crawfish Boil; plus Smoked King Crab Legs; Grilled Rainbow Trout with Brown Butter and Grilled Lemon; and Kev's famous Red Beans and Rice.

description:
S01 E05 — Go Burger or Go Home!
Tonight is a trio of backyard burgers! We're making Oklahoma Smashed Onion Burgers, New York Steakhouse Burgers and Fries, and Bougie Castle-Inspired Sliders.

title: Grill'n After Dark
description:
S01 E03 — Midnight Sandwich Express
It's sandwich night! We're making our favorite handheld late-night delights: Chicken Parm Hero, (Not a Philly) Cheesesteak, and Bodega Chopped Cheese. We're going to light the grills, pour some drinks, and show you how to make 'em in your backyard.

title: Grill'n After Dark
description:
S01 E06 — Breakfast After Dark
We're making our late-night breakfast for dinner standards with the Waffle House All-Star, Steak and Eggs, and a Fast Food Sausage Breakfast Sandwich.

title: Grill'n After Dark
description:
S01 E02 — Late Night Mexican Food Truck
The Grill Dads bring late-night Mexican food truck eats to your backyard with pollo al pastor tacos, Mission-style carne asada burritos, and mini beef chimichangas.

title: Grill'n After Dark
description:
S01 E01 — Winner, Winner, Chicken Dinner
Tonight is all about chicken comfort-food dishes: a Gochujang Hot Honey Chicken Sandwich, Almost Buffalo Wings, and a Spicy Chicken Salad Wrap. We're going to light the grills, pour some drinks, and show you how to make 'em in your backyard.

title: Grill'n After Dark
description:
S01 E04 — Better Than Delivery Pizza Night
We're grilling our three favorite styles of pizza tonight: Chicago Tavern with Sausage and Hot Giardiniera, New York Ricotta and Hot Honey, and a spicy Detroit Pepperoni.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E03 — Crispy Rolled Pork Belly and Risotto
Jamie shares more fabulous one-pan dishes: foolproof tray-baked salmon in a bag; super-easy tomato fritters that you can rattle out in a frying pan; and roasted rolled pork and a risotto that are BOTH cooked in the same casserole pan. Result!

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E04 — Not Your Nonna's Gnocchi and Meatballs
In this episode Jamie takes midweek meals up a notch, knocking out a flavour-packed, simple gnocchi supper and giant spicy meatballs full of delicious time-saving cheats, and turns a family favourite on its head with his upside-down fish pie.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E05 — Sweet Potato Chilli and Homemade Nachos
Jamie shows us a delicious range of one-pan dishes: a super-speedy smashed lemongrass chicken; flavour-packed sweet potato chilli with homemade nachos; and a chocolate party tray cake with retro tinned-mandarin and buttercream filling.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E06 — Jamie's Outrageously Good Pulled Pork
Jamie cooks two one-pan recipes that are ideal for busy lives: his take on shakshuka with asparagus, broccoli & harissa; and an outrageously good pulled pork that can be batched up, frozen and used in loads of meals whenever you're ready.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E01 — Weeknight Roast Lamb and Eggplant
Jamie kicks off his new one-pan series with a simplified and delicious frying-pan pasta, a clever twist on a fish pie that's full of flavour with none of the fuss, and a sublime roast lamb feast with a fantastic hack to speed up cooking.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E02 — Speedy Chicken and Mushroom Puff Pastry Pie
Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes that provide a perfect solution for busy life: a superfast, flavour-packed smoky noodle soup; the cleverest homemade bread in a pan; and a chicken & mushroom pie with a time-saving tip for perfect pastry.

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E05 — Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples
Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E06 — Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta
Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!
